Following up on this one. List endpoints use cursor-based pagination, so you won't need to pull everything in one call.

Best,
Nadia Goldberg

draft.subject: Dark mode + getting your first project going
draft.body:
Hi Ines,

Thanks for flagging dark mode — your ticket is still open with us, and to be straight with you: dark mode isn't available yet, but it's on the roadmap.

In the meantime, I'd love to help you get value out of Wrenfield now. Projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so creating your first project is the quickest way to see how it fits your team's work.

Want me to walk you through that first project on a short call this week? Happy to work around your schedule.

Best,
Nadia
